checks: Only adjective ‘accurate’ is the intended complement of ‘was’; the adverb and nouns do not fit. Clarified that accurate means close to the actual voltage and that two matching measurements alone do not establish accuracy. Corrected the zh-TW cloze to fit the gloss; all choices checked.

activeQuestion.prompt: The technician recorded the voltage twice to ensure that the reading was ____.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 技術人員記錄了兩次電壓，以確保讀值是____。

options.whyZh: 此處 was 後用形容詞 accurate 描述讀值，意為「接近實際電壓值」。重複記錄可以互相核對，但兩次讀值相同不代表一定準確。
accurately 是副詞，不能作為此處 was 後的補語。
accuracy 是名詞，不能直接將 reading 等同於準確度。
複數名詞不能作為單數 reading 的此處形容詞補語。
